function: DDPG agent jointly controls UAV flight (direction, speed) and beamforming vectors to maximize sum rate; fine-tuned LLaVA predicts user trajectories and extracts the state (pp. 5-8).
system: Three UAVs, each with an 8-antenna ULA, serving two single-antenna mobile users each; probabilistic LoS air-to-ground channel; 1 MHz, wavelength 0.125 m; no RIS (pp. 3, 10).
method: DDPG reinforcement learning on a state vector from a LoRA fine-tuned LLaVA multi-modal LLM (supervised fine-tuning for user trajectory prediction); single-agent (pp. 6-9).
data_channel: Simulated probabilistic LoS/NLoS air-to-ground channel with complex Gaussian fading (p. 4); multi-modal images and sensed positions collected in the AirSim simulator for fine-tuning (pp. 6, 10); no measured data.
test_conditions: Trained in the AirSim scene of Fig. 6 (3 UAVs, 6 MUs); tested in a distinct environment with other obstacles (Fig. 12); varied UAV counts and speeds (pp. 10-13).
baselines: All learned: TdDRLS (DDPG on positions), SmpMmdS (RNN prediction plus M2LLM-DRL), MmpSmdS, ToBtS (DDPG trajectory, RNN beam tracking); Kimi, DeepSeek, RNN predictors; SAC; no non-learned baseline (pp. 10-11).
metrics: Average sum rate (Mbps/Hz), average distance prediction error of user trajectory (m), average reward per episode, degradation in a new environment (pp. 10-13).
complexity: Orders only: M2LLM inference O(HWC + N_TRANS L^2 + D_IM D_TE); DRL training and execution orders also given (p. 9); no runtime, FLOPs or parameter count.
q1_support: p. 4: "We apply the probabilistic line-of-sight (LoS) transmission model to describe the wireless channel between the UAVs and the MUs". Custom simulated channel (Eqs. 1-2, complex Gaussian small-scale fading); no 3GPP TR 38.811/38.901, DeepMIMO or measured channel is named.
q2_support: p. 12: "we train the agent in the environment depicted in Fig. 6 and create a distinct testing environment"; p. 13: "differs significantly from the training environment, such as the number and position of obstacles".
q3_support: p. 10: "we apply the following schemes as the benchmark schemes": TdDRLS, SmpMmdS, MmpSmdS and ToBtS are all learned (DDPG, RNN); no non-learned benchmark such as an optimization or fixed-trajectory method is compared.
q4_support: p. 9: "the inference complexity of the M2LLM is O(HW C + N TRANS L2 + DIM DTE )"; training and execution orders are also given in Section IV-F.
notes: Area 6: beam control with trajectory for UAV (aerial) links that also sense; ISAC (area 5) also fits but area 6 is more specific. Trajectory (above PHY) is learned jointly with beamforming (PHY), so above_phy does not apply. All benchmarks are learned, so q3 is 0. The channel is a probabilistic LoS model, not 3GPP, so q1 is 0.
